title: chore(examples): add e-commerce layout styles [part 2]
body:
_This is part 2 of the series "e-commerce demo"._

## Description

This adds the default styles of the application layout to be usable. **It doesn't style the widgets.**

## Notes

- The style properties are alphabetically ordered

## Preview

[See preview →](https://deploy-preview-3800--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce)
